results.sql: CREATE TABLE "boost_tokens" (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), post_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES posts(id), amount_paid_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, paystack_reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, boost_duration_hours INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, boosted_from TEXT NOT NULL, boosted_until TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'expired', 'cancelled')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')))
